opportunities.title: Research Awards (Research and Travel Grants)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards will not be made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications will not be considered.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants of £500 to £5,000 to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains. No period, geographic or disciplinary restrictions; covers archaeology, art history, architectural and buildings history, material culture (including books and manuscripts), history of collecting, and intellectual enquiry into the human past. Awards made annually with possible renewal for up to two further years (max three years).

opportunities.title: Hugh Phillips Award
opportunities.summary: Named research award within the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme, supporting research into the material past (Britain pre-1800). Applications must be received by midnight on 15 January, references by 21 January.

opportunities.title: Margaret and Tom Jones Memorial Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Two references are required for Margaret and Tom Jones Memorial awards.
opportunities.summary: Named research award within the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme, supporting research into the material past. Applications must be received by midnight on 15 January, references by 21 January.

opportunities.title: Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales
opportunities.summary: Named research award within the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme supporting research archaeology in Wales. Applications must be received by midnight on 15 January, references by 21 January.

opportunities.title: Open Research
opportunities.summary: Named research award within the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme supporting open research into the material past. Applications must be received by midnight on 15 January, references by 21 January.

opportunities.title: Beatrice de Cardi Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Two references are required for Beatrice De Cardi awards.
opportunities.summary: Named research award within the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme, supporting research into the material past (notably Middle East/Arabia archaeology). Applications must be received by midnight on 7 April, references by 14 April.

opportunities.title: Janet Arnold Awards

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.summary: Church conservation grants with two application rounds each year (31 March and 31 August). No references are required for Morris applications.

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants
opportunities.summary: Textile conservation and research grants. Applications are made via the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants form on the Grants Application Portal. No references are required for Linda Parry applications.
